executive_summary: Recent CISA KEV and GitHub advisories reveal critical authentication bypass, code injection, and XSS issues affecting cloud, Linux, and web services, providing practical material for defensive labs and secure coding exercises.

signals.title: GPUStack improper authentication vulnerability
signals.what_changed: CISA added GPUStack to Known Exploited Vulnerabilities on 2026-11-09
signals.why_it_matters: Allows unauthenticated admin access and code execution in GPUStack deployments, impacting cloud workloads
signals.application: Test authentication hardening in containerized GPU workloads

signals.title: OpenSSH password authentication bypass
signals.what_changed: CISA added OpenSSH vulnerability to KEV on 2026-11-09
signals.why_it_matters: Enables authentication bypass via unexpected status code, affecting SSH services
signals.application: Create a lab to verify SSH login without valid credentials using crafted packets

signals.title: SignalWire FreeSwitch code injection
signals.what_changed: CISA added FreeSwitch vulnerability to KEV on 2026-11-09
signals.why_it_matters: Permits arbitrary command execution and credential disclosure via configuration
signals.application: Perform input validation testing on SIP server configurations

signals.title: OHIF Viewers DOM-based XSS via MIME type
signals.why_it_matters: Allows XSS attacks when MIME type is manipulated, affecting web applications
signals.application: Implement MIME type validation and output encoding in web projects

signals.title: Forge ASN.1 BIT STRING resource exhaustion
signals.why_it_matters: Can cause denial of service or code execution via crafted DER data
signals.application: Write defensive parsers that enforce length constraints on BIT STRING

experiment.title: OpenSSH Authentication Bypass Lab
experiment.objective: Demonstrate authentication bypass in SSH using crafted status code response
steps: Start a vulnerable OpenSSH container exposing port 2222
From a separate host, send a malformed SSH handshake with unexpected status code to trigger bypass
Observe successful login without password authentication
Record the session and verify logs showing the unexpected status code
expected_evidence: Successful SSH session without valid credentials
Log entry indicating receipt of unexpected status code
Proof of concept captured in screenshots or logs
experiment.stop_condition: Authentication bypass observed or 60 minutes elapsed

discarded: Attacking live production systems, unrelated vulnerabilities, non‑lab environments
